title: boretta cantabrica var. bicolor
intro: Boretta cantabrica var. bicolor, commonly known as Boreta, is a flowering plant species within the mint family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Boreta include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Boreta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
